sast.rationale: Bandit rates shell injection HIGH and hard-coded password strings LOW; LOW and MEDIUM code findings are reviewed in the pull request.

sca.rationale: pip-audit gives no severity, so an advisory without a mapped severity counts as HIGH and blocks.

secrets.rationale: Any detected credential blocks and is rotated; a leaked secret has no acceptable severity.

iac.rationale: Misconfigurations at HIGH or above can expose statements data or access.

dast.rationale: DAST findings are observed on the running service, so MEDIUM already blocks.
